c844522e17: The same intelligence, but each person accesses only what their role allows.
976613c5ba: The AI Server does not give everyone the same access. Each user interacts with the intelligence according to their role: the operator gets the context of their task, the shift supervisor that of their area, management the full picture. It is not a permissions layer stuck on top that is easy to get around: the intelligence itself respects the permission before answering. If someone asks about something outside their scope, the system simply does not answer.
dab151740b: Why it matters. Generic AI tools do not understand hierarchies or confidentiality: they answer whoever asks. In a company, that is unworkable. Role-based control makes it possible to deploy AI across the whole organisation without opening sensitive information to people who should not see it.

120bb4da2e: Permissions follow an open, auditable European standard, not a manufacturer's proprietary rules.
9b534b5f1b: The AI Server's permissions are not a closed invention of the manufacturer: they are expressed in ODRL, the standard language for describing data usage rights, in line with the UNE 0087 standard.
